prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1058; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On the reported date, I responded to a sideswipe collision on a roadway in League City, Texas. Driver 1 told me they were changing lanes when the vehicle on their right, operated by Driver 2, moved into the same space and made contact along the driver's side. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched this account in its sequence and location. Two independent witnesses at the scene described the same lane change and impact, and photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels that is consistent with a glancing strike of this kind. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was noted by anyone present or in my review. Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time, and both the witnesses and I observed Passenger in the vehicle after the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the shoulder, which EMS personnel assessed at the scene and which fits the direction and force of the impact. Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy for the vehicle involved. Both vehicles were drivable from the scene, and no citations were issued.
